flamegraph.self_help: Cost in this function, excluding child calls

compare.title: Compare profiles
compare.subtitle: What got hotter or cooler in one period against another. Set both freely.
compare.baseline_overlaps: This baseline would overlap the period it is compared with.

compare.overlap: The two periods share time: what was captured in the shared part counts on both sides.

changed.title: Most changed functions
changed.none: No function's own cost changed between the two periods.
changed.select_hint: Mark this function in the flame graph

empty.comparison_title: Nothing captured in the comparison period
